additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484895-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R5 170001805] Cable check Fail CRM:03432000037
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0484895
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: EWII AS
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R5 170001805
Charger ID / Serial No.:
9ff7h3
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
QA 21 and 22 is not closing properly.
1. Check XD10.1 connector, I recommend removing the connector from each parts and reattach it. Try again charging session and if it is works.
2. If it fails please measure 24v between C1 and C2 of both contactors I recommend measuring between XD41:37B and XD41:25B for QA21 and  XD41:38D and XD41:25B for QA22
2.1  If you don´t measure 24V at C1 and C2 for both contactors, please measure in KF14 CCS-A out(J1) TrO to XD41:25B.
2.1.1 If you don´t measure 24V at TrO then please replace KF14.
2.2 If you measure 24V at C1 and C2 for both contactors, please turn off the charger and place crocodile tips in WC22 to WC23 and check during cable check for at least 200V.
2.2.1 If you don´t measure any output please replace QA21 and 22.
2.2.2 If you measure output of the contactors and still fails lets check TF2. Please measure between XD41:43B and XD41:44D. You should measure around 3-4V.
2.3 If you don´t measure 3-4V try swapping TF1 with TF2, if the problem persist with TF2. Replace TF2.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
